items.summaryZh: 梅赛德斯为2026年美国大奖赛推出独特的蓝色涂装，车队希望车手安东内利能在周日赢得F1世界冠军。

items.originalTitle: Mercedes F1 unveils dramatic new look for United States Grand Prix
detailZh: 梅赛德斯为美国大奖赛推出全新外观设计
梅赛德斯为2026年美国大奖赛推出独特的蓝色涂装，包括匹配的赛车手赛车服和道路车辆
对于梅赛德斯粉丝来说，这里是关于银箭的最新消息，包括F1新闻、车手更新、赛车发展和比赛分析
梅赛德斯本周末的美国大奖赛将带着这款独一无二的蓝色涂装，因为车队希望其车手安东内利能在周日赢得F1世界冠军
与MANUFAKTUR合作开发，梅赛德斯品牌的个性化项目，设计将W17的常用银色换成了蓝色。汽车的前部真正展示了这种新颜色。
MANUFAKTUR是一项服务，允许梅赛德斯-奔驰、梅赛德斯-AMG和梅赛德斯-迈巴赫的客户通过定制油漆、材料和手工触感来个性化他们的道路车辆。在美国，梅赛德斯销售的约一半汽车都至少选择了MANUFAKTUR的一项特色功能。
除此之外，乔治·拉塞尔将身穿复古蓝色赛车服，安东内利将身穿钢蓝色赛车服，每位车手都将使用一辆与赛车颜色相匹配的梅赛德斯-AMG GT 4门轿跑车。这不是一个糟糕的额外奖励。车队在美洲赛车场的维修区也将进行MANUFAKTUR改造。
为了进一步庆祝涂装，将在南国会、艾米餐厅、特科瓦斯、W酒店和SCHEELS举行活动，而其免费的粉丝中心将于周四在400国会大道开放。
“Austin也将是我们赛道外的一个重要周末，整个城市将举办多项商业活动，”车队负责人Toto Wolff在车队预告中表示。“其中最重要的是AMG和MANUFAKTUR的接管，整个周末将展现梅赛德斯家族的性能、工艺和个性。”
“这是梅赛德斯在三次比赛中使用的第二种特别涂装。在三次比赛前的Sepang，车队通过交换其银色和青色的位置来庆祝与Petronas的冠军合作伙伴关系。”
“美国大奖赛开始了另一个要求严格的连续三站赛事，”Wolff指出。“有很多事情要处理，但我们不会过于乐观。我们的首要任务是眼前的周末：执行得很好，最大化我们的表现，并按部就班地对待每一场比赛。”
detailEn: Mercedes F1 unveils dramatic new look for United States Grand Prix
Mercedes has unveiled a striking blue livery for the 2026 United States Grand Prix, complete with matching driver race suits and road cars
For Mercedes fans. All the latest from the Silver Arrows, with F1 news, driver updates, car development and race analysis from Brackley and Brixworth.
Mercedes is heading to this weekend's United States Grand Prix with a one-off blue livery as the team hopes that its driver Kimi Antonelli will clinch the Formula 1 world championship on Sunday.
Developed with MANUFAKTUR, the Mercedes brand's personalisation programme, the design swaps the W17’s usual silver for blue. The nose of the car really shows off the new colour.

MANUFAKTUR is the service that lets Mercedes-Benz, Mercedes-AMG and Mercedes-Maybach customers personalise their road cars with bespoke paint, materials and handcrafted touches. About half of the cars Mercedes sells in the US are ordered with at least one MANUFAKTUR feature.

On top of this, George Russell will wear a vintage blue race suit and Antonelli a steel blue one, and each driver will use a Mercedes-AMG GT 4-Door Coupe finished to match. Not a bad bonus. The team’s garage at the Circuit of the Americas will also get a MANUFAKTUR makeover.
To further celebrate the paint job, activations are planned at South Congress, Amy’s, Tecovas, the W Hotel and SCHEELS, while its free fan hub opens at 400 Congress Avenue from Thursday.

“Austin will also be an important weekend for us off track, with a number of commercial activities taking place across the city,” team principal Toto Wolff said in the team's preview. “At the heart of that will be AMG and the MANUFAKTUR takeover, bringing to life the performance, craftsmanship and individuality of the wider Mercedes family throughout the weekend.”

It is the second special livery Mercedes has run in three races. Two races ago at Sepang, the team celebrated its title partnership with Petronas by swapping the positions of its silver and turquoise.

"The United States Grand Prix begins another demanding triple-header," Wolff notes. "There is plenty at stake, but we won’t get ahead of ourselves. The priority is the weekend in front of us: execute well, maximise our performance and take each race as it comes."

涂装设计由MANUFAKTUR开发，替换了W17的银色涂装
keyPointsEn: Mercedes introduces a new blue livery for the United States Grand Prix
The design is developed by MANUFAKTUR, replacing the W17's silver livery

detailZh: F1车队展示了特别为美国大奖赛准备的丹宁牛仔装、牛仔帽和哥斯拉系列
一级方程式车队和车手们正在拥抱德克萨斯州的氛围，为2026年美国大奖赛做准备
赛车文化超越赛道。车手生活方式、时尚、旅行、设计和那些让赛车不仅仅是一项运动的故事
美国大奖赛是少数几个几乎每个车队都会有所庆祝的赛事之一。一级方程式巡回赛本周末抵达德克萨斯州，让我们来盘点一下车队带来的丹宁牛仔装、牛仔帽和西部风格的商品。
奥斯汀自豪地展示着来自红牛、凯迪拉克、威廉姆斯、维斯塔潘和兰多·诺里斯本人的收藏，甚至连F1也带来了自己的装备。
红牛全力以赴，因为它的引擎合作伙伴福特在美国赛车场为其主场赛事而疯狂地推出了Raptor系列。车队将穿着由Raptor和美国西部启发的Castore系列赛车服、靴子、夹克和衬衫。车手维斯塔潘和伊萨克·哈德贾本周末将身穿白色赛车服，以庆祝这一场合。
“奥斯汀总是个充满乐趣的周末，”红牛商业总监保罗·甘多菲说。“今年，我们将比以往任何时候都要更大规模，无论是在赛道上还是在整个城市。”
福特赛车总经理威尔·福特补充说：“我们非常喜欢ORBR车队对Raptor精神的拥抱，从赛车服到维修区。”
红牛和新时代公司还推出了一款深红色带有奶油色帽檐的奥斯汀帽子，上面印有维斯塔潘的3号和哈吉尔的6号。
维斯塔潘的狮子头戴牛仔帽，出现在他独一无二的奥斯汀头盔上，同样的主题也出现在他自己的‘释放狮子奥斯汀’系列中，其中包括一件上面印有牛仔狮子和‘奥斯汀，德克萨斯州’字样的87美元连帽衫。头盔的复制品从93美元的1:4比例模型开始销售。
哈斯车队将奥斯汀视为其最重要的主场赛事，转而选择了哥斯拉。作为其与日本工作室东宝长期合作的一部分，车队于周一公布了以哥斯拉为主题的涂装，埃斯蒂班·奥康和奥利弗·贝尔曼将身穿配套的赛车服。19日，车队系列帽衫和车手T恤衫开始销售，同时还有海报和拼图。从10月23日至25日，粉丝可以在巴顿克里克广场购物中心看到哥斯拉展示车并购买该系列商品。还有一款55美元的新时代奥斯汀帽子。
‘通过推出续集涂装，我们在一级方程式赛场上开辟了新的领域，这是我们非常自豪的，’哈斯车队负责人小松英昭说。
凯迪拉克的Austin胶囊系列源自其与Tommy Hilfiger的合作，并于10月13日开始销售。该系列包括售价321美元的浅色水洗牛仔夹克，一件带有银色箔面涂层的女士牛仔背心，一件T恤，一件背心，以及售价74美元的牛仔帽，紧随迈阿密和墨西哥胶囊系列。拉斯维加斯版预计将在11月上市。
‘我们从Tommy衣橱的标志性单品开始设计’，Tommy Hilfiger首席设计官Lee Holman说道。
威廉姆斯车队今年将装备供应商改为New Era，推出了Austin赛车系列，包括售价180美元的牛仔夹克，售价85美元的牛仔帽，牛仔司机帽和印有‘Austin, TX’和‘Est. 1977’的西部风格T恤。
梅赛德斯-奔驰和奥迪则保持了简洁的风格，推出了特别版的adidas Austin帽，每顶售价61美元。
诺里斯的LN4品牌走了一条不同的路线。兰多的原始服务部门是一个由12件套组成的系列，灵感来源于70年代的赛车车库，从奥斯汀市中心的一个改造后的加油站出售，直到周日。
F1的自己的系列包括一个如你所见带有NAHMIAS的收藏。轮胎供应商倍耐力还提供一款售价94美元的奥斯汀领奖台帽子。
美国大奖赛将于10月23日至25日在美国赛车场举行。
detailEn: F1 teams reveal special United States GP collections with denim, cowboy hats and Godzilla
Formula 1 teams and drivers are embracing the spirit of Texas for the 2026 United States Grand Prix
Motorsport culture beyond the track. Driver lifestyle, fashion, travel, design and the stories that make racing more than a sport.

The United States Grand Prix is one of the few races where almost every team will do something to celebrate. The Formula 1 circus arrives in Texas this weekend, so let's do a roundup of the denim, cowboy hats and Western-styled merchandise the teams have brought with them.
Austin is proudly showing off collections from Red Bull, Cadillac, Williams, Max Verstappen and Lando Norris themselves, and even F1 has brought its own kit.

Red Bull has gone all out as its engine partner, Ford, goes Raptor crazy at the Circuit of the Americas for its home race. The team will be wearing a Castore collection of race suits, boots, jackets and shirts inspired by the Raptor and the American West. Drivers Max Verstappen and Isack Hadjar will be wearing white race suits this weekend to celebrate the occasion.
“Austin is always a weekend where we have a lot of fun,” said Red Bull commercial director Paul Gandolfi. “This year, we’re going bigger than ever, both at the circuit and across the city.”
Ford Racing general manager Will Ford added: "We love how the ORBR team has embraced the spirit of Raptor, from the race suits to the pit garages."
Red Bull and New Era have also produced an Austin cap in maroon with a cream peak, carrying Verstappen’s No. 3 and Hadjar’s No. 6.

Verstappen’s lion wears a cowboy hat on his one-off Austin helmet, and the same theme features in his own Unleash the Lion Austin collection, which includes an $87 hoodie with the cowboy lion above the words “Austin, Texas”. Replicas of the helmet start at $93 for a 1:4 scale model.

Haas, which considers Austin its biggest home race, has turned to Godzilla. As part of its season-long partnership with Japanese studio TOHO, the team revealed a Godzilla-themed livery on Monday, and Esteban Ocon and Oliver Bearman will wear matching race suits. A collection of team hoodies and driver T-shirts went on sale on 19 October, alongside posters and jigsaw puzzles. Fans can see a Godzilla show car and buy the range at Barton Creek Square mall from 23 to 25 October. There is also a $55 New Era Austin cap.
“We’re breaking new ground in Formula 1 by launching a sequel livery, and it’s something we’re very proud of,” said Haas team principal Ayao Komatsu.

Cadillac’s Austin capsule stems from its partnership with Tommy Hilfiger, and went on sale on 13 October. It includes a light-wash denim jacket at $321, a women’s denim vest with a silver foil coating, a T-shirt, a tank top and a $74 denim cap, and follows capsules for Miami and Mexico. A Las Vegas edition is due in November.
“We started with icons of the Tommy wardrobe,” said Tommy Hilfiger chief design officer Lee Holman.

Williams, which changed to New Era as its kit supplier this year, has an Austin race collection with a $180 denim jacket, an $85 cowboy hat, denim trucker caps and T-shirts with Western-style lettering reading “Austin, TX” and “Est. 1977”.
Mercedes and Audi have kept it easy, with special edition adidas Austin caps at $61 each.

Norris’s LN4 brand has gone down a different route. Lando’s Original Service Department is a 12-piece collection inspired by 1970s racing garages, sold from a converted petrol station in downtown Austin until Sunday.
F1’s own range includes a collection with NAHMIAS as you can see below. Tyre supplier Pirelli also has a $94 Austin podium cap.
The United States Grand Prix takes place at the Circuit of the Americas from 23 to 25 October.

items.originalTitle: Five things to watch out for at the F1 United States GP
items.summaryEn: The 2026 Formula 1 season is nearing its end, with the United States Grand Prix at Austin's Circuit of the Americas this weekend kicking off a triple-header that also includes Mexico City and Sao Paulo. Kimi Antonelli could become world champion there.
detailZh: F1美国大奖赛五大看点
本周末奥斯汀举办其广受欢迎的大奖赛，安东内利可能在此成为F1世界冠军
2026赛季F1已接近尾声，锦标赛如今前往北美，进行今年最后一次海外飞地赛事。
本周末奥斯汀的美洲赛道举办美国大奖赛，开启包含墨西哥城和圣保罗在内的三连赛。
就目前情况来看，2026赛季还剩六站比赛，这意味着世界冠军将在这一最后阶段决出——其中一项冠军可能会在得克萨斯州揭晓。
因此，以下是美国大奖赛上值得关注的五件事。
安东内利的加冕时刻？
梅赛德斯一直被预期能够驾驭规则切换，因为数十年来它一直在打造世界级的动力单元，而这是2026年规则体系的关键部分。这使得银箭车队从一开始就成为博彩公司眼中两项冠军的热门，不过基于2025年的表现，许多人曾认为乔治·拉塞尔会拿下车手总冠军。
这位28岁的车手可以说交出了他当时七个赛季F1生涯中最好的一个赛季，他最大化发挥了W16的潜力，最终获得年度第四，并领先新秀队友基米·安东内利169分。诚然，在经历了这样一个起伏不定的新秀赛季后，安东内利不可能在仅仅第二年就成为世界冠军的料。
然而他确实做到了：这位20岁的车手目前领先第二名拉塞尔102分。安东内利的表现极其稳定，令人印象深刻，他拿下了14个领奖台、8场胜利和6个杆位。只有在巴库，这位意大利车手的速度不足以进入前三，而他其他未能登上领奖台的结果都是由于赛车问题造成的。
这一切意味着安东内利可以在本周末的奥斯汀锁定他的首个总冠军，这也是他第一次有机会做到这一点。这或许不太可能——他需要比拉塞尔多拿23分——但这仍然凸显了他的统治力。
另一方面，梅赛德斯还无法锁定车队总冠军，因为它需要带着对第二名法拉利215分的优势离开奥斯汀。考虑到目前优势为134分，墨西哥是这家德国厂商自2021年以来夺得首个总冠军的最早机会。
但梅赛德斯是夺冠热门吗？
现实地说，安东内利本周末成为世界冠军的唯一途径是赢得美国大奖赛，并且拉塞尔获得第九名。如果是在2026年早些时候，当梅赛德斯从杆位赢下开局六轮时，那么前者看起来非常有可能——但现在不是了，这一切都要归功于红牛。
这支奥地利车队赛季初起步缓慢，在前六场比赛中只获得两次领奖台，但他们用持续不断的升级做出了回应，其中或许最具决定性的一次升级发生在上个月的巴库。
那个周末，马克斯·维斯塔潘获得第二名，紧跟在拉塞尔身后，随后前往雪邦——一条特性完全不同的赛道——赢得了他在2026年的首场胜利。这位四届世界冠军随后在上一站的 Singapore 冲刺赛和大奖赛中双双获胜。
因此，维斯塔潘不仅在过去三场比赛中从杆位夺冠，还在最近八场大奖赛中的七场登上领奖台，上演了令人想起去年的赛季末复苏。这让围场内许多人将小红牛22称为“全场标杆”，而随着它现在在不止一种类型的赛道上都表现出色，红牛可以说将以夺冠热门身份前往奥斯汀。
如果维斯塔潘获胜，这将是他的第五个美国大奖赛冠军——全部来自最近六届比赛。
迈凯伦试图用奥斯汀升级阻止下滑趋势
奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里，迈凯伦，兰多·诺里斯，迈凯伦
红牛复苏后， certainly 一支受害的车队是迈凯伦，在几个月的时间里，它从梅赛德斯最接近的挑战者变成了第四好的车队。沃金车队凭借兰多·诺里斯在布达佩斯和赞德沃特背靠背获胜，如果不是不合时宜的虚拟安全车，他本可以在马德里实现四场比赛中的第三场胜利。
但自那以后，车队状态下滑，在接下来的三场比赛——阿塞拜疆、马来西亚、新加坡三连赛——中未能登上领奖台，现在面临着以仅领先红牛七分的优势保住第三名的战斗。
尽管卫冕冠军为马来西亚带来了升级版MCL40，而且升级似乎按预期发挥了作用，但迈凯伦只是在研发竞争中被对手超越了。本周末情况可能会改变，因为这家英国品牌为奥斯汀带来了另一组升级，主要集中在前部。
首席设计师罗布·马歇尔表示：“我们为本次赛事带来了一套适度的升级，旨在改善一些制动可靠性和性能问题。”
我们也有一些小的底板改动需要测试。过去五六场比赛中，大家都看到了要预测顶级车队之间的相对表现有多么困难。显然，这里有很多因素在起作用：赛车在升级、赛车适合某些赛道、车手喜欢某些赛道，以及其他因素。
最近几场比赛对我们来说不太顺利，但我认为我们正在重新变得更强，奥斯汀可能更适合我们的赛车。
诺里斯与队友奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里在新加坡冲刺赛中的冲突，本周末可能也会再次被提起，不过迈凯伦似乎已经为这起事件画上了句号。
新加坡大奖赛之后又有更多车手消息，哈斯确认将让F2积分榜领先者拉斐尔·卡马拉在2027年完成F1首秀。这位21岁的巴西车手将接替埃斯特班·奥康，并可能在几项合同细节敲定后与现任车手奥利弗·贝尔曼搭档。
这对卡马拉来说是一次快速崛起，他在2025年赢得F3冠军，前一年则拿下FRECA冠军，这也意味着理论上除了哈斯之外，2027年唯一尚未确认的车手席位只剩下小红牛（小红牛）。
利亚姆·劳森和阿维德·林德布拉德目前为这支位于法恩扎的车队效力，两人都为小红牛领跑中游集团做出了贡献，车队以100分排名第五。虽然几乎可以确定，积38分排名第11位的新秀林德布拉德将在下赛季留队，但排名第九的劳森身上仍存有疑问。
并非他们应该如此：这位24岁的新西兰人正处于职业生涯最佳状态，除五场比赛外每场都有积分入账。但正如红牛一贯的情况，其青训输送带上还有另一位年轻车手，那就是卡马拉的F2冠军竞争对手尼古拉·措洛夫。
这家奥地利公司需要做出决定：是留下劳森，还是给措洛夫一个机会。问题只在于劳森从今往后何去何从？考虑到伊萨克·哈贾尔的状态，他重返红牛——他2025年起步的地方——可能性不大，而长期留在小红牛对任何一方来说都不是真正可行的选择。
所以这个周末预计会出现那些问题。但就目前情况而言，劳森预计会留到2027年，而2028年或许是他需要寻找新车队的年份。
今年有多少次超出赛道限制？
皮埃尔·加斯利，阿尔派车队；弗兰科·科拉平托，阿尔派车队
“我要把酒店的一个枕头垫在他屁股下面，这样他才能真正看到路，”梅赛德斯车队老板托托·沃尔夫在新加坡大奖赛上说道。这是对安东内利四次超出赛道限制的回应，理论上，这是触发五秒罚时的阈值。但这位意大利车手逃过了处罚，因为其中一次是由刹车问题导致的。
尽管如此，赛道限制是安东内利经常难以处理的问题，而且毫无疑问，这在本周末将成为一个重大话题，这无疑会让他感到沮丧。在美洲赛道，由于极长的缓冲区与高速弯道，这始终是焦点，去年的比赛中就有32圈成绩被删除。
这比赛历上的大多数赛道都要多，因此本周末无疑会成为另一个讨论点——尤其是在排位赛中，车手们比在任何其他环节都更用力地逼近极限。
detailEn: Five things to watch out for at the F1 United States GP
Austin hosts its popular grand prix this weekend, where Kimi Antonelli could become F1 world champion
The end of the 2026 Formula 1 season is in sight as the championship now heads to North America for the last of its flyaway races this year.
Austin hosts the United States Grand Prix this weekend at the popular Circuit of the Americas, kick-starting a triple-header that includes Mexico City and Sao Paulo.
As things stand, there are six rounds remaining in the 2026 campaign, meaning world titles are won and lost in this final stretch - one of which may be decided in Texas.
So here are five things to watch out for at the United States GP.
Antonelli’s crowning moment?

Mercedes was always expected to master the regulation switch thanks to decades of it producing world-class power units, a key part of the 2026 ruleset. It led to the Silver Arrows being the bookies’ favourite for both titles from early on, though based on 2025, many assumed George Russell would take the drivers’ crown.

The 28-year-old produced arguably the best campaign of his then seven-season-long F1 career by maximising the W16 to finish fourth in the standings and 169 points above rookie team-mate Kimi Antonelli. Surely, after such an up-and-down rookie season, Antonelli wouldn’t be world champion material in only year two.

Yet he has been: the 20-year-old holds a 102-point advantage over second-placed Russell. It’s been mighty impressive how consistent Antonelli has been with 14 podiums, eight victories and six poles. Only in Baku was the Italian not quick enough for a top-three finish, with his other non-podium results happening due to a car issue.

It all means that Antonelli can clinch his maiden title in Austin this weekend, the first opportunity for him to do so. It may be unlikely - needing to outscore Russell by 23 points - but it still underlines his dominance.

Mercedes, on the other hand, is not yet able to seal the constructors’ title, as it would need to leave Austin with a 215-point gap over second-placed Ferrari. Considering the advantage currently stands at 134, Mexico is the earliest opportunity for the German marque to take its first championship since 2021.
But is Mercedes favourite for victory?

Realistically, the only way Antonelli can become world champion this weekend is if he wins the United States Grand Prix and Russell finishes ninth. If it were earlier in 2026, when Mercedes won the opening six rounds from pole, then the former would appear very likely - but not now, all thanks to Red Bull.
The Austrian outfit started the campaign slowly with two podiums in the first six, yet responded to that with relentless upgrades and perhaps the most decisive of those came in Baku last month.

That weekend Max Verstappen finished second, closely behind Russell, before going to Sepang, a track with completely different characteristics, to take his first win of 2026. The four-time world champion then followed that up with a victory in both the Singapore sprint and grand prix last time out.

So not only has Verstappen won the last three races from pole, but he has also finished on the podium in seven of the last eight grands prix, staging a late resurgence reminiscent of last year. It has led to many within the paddock to label the RB22 as the ‘class of the field’ and with it now performing at more than one type of circuit, Red Bull arguably heads into Austin as favourite for victory.
If Verstappen wins, it would be his fifth United States GP victory - all coming across the last six editions.
McLaren attempts to stop downward trajectory with Austin upgrades
Oscar Piastri, McLaren, Lando Norris, McLaren

One team suffering from Red Bull’s resurgence is certainly McLaren which, in the space of a couple of months, has gone from Mercedes’ nearest challenger to being the fourth-best squad. The Woking outfit won back-to-back in Budapest and Zandvoort via Lando Norris, who would have made it three victories in four at Madrid had it not been for an untimely VSC.

But since then it has regressed, failing to score a podium in the three races since - the Azerbaijan-Malaysia-Singapore triple header - and now faces a fight to hold onto third with just a seven-point advantage over Red Bull.

That is despite the reigning champions bringing an upgraded MCL40 to Malaysia and, although the updates seemingly worked as intended, McLaren was simply out-developed by its rivals. That may change this weekend as the British marque is bringing another set of upgrades to Austin, largely focused on the front of the car.
"We’re bringing a modest selection of upgrades for this event, aimed at improving some braking reliability and performance issues," said chief designer Rob Marshall.

"We also have some small floor changes to test. We have all seen how difficult it is to predict the relative performance of the top teams over the last five or six races. Obviously, there are many factors in play here: cars being upgraded, cars suiting and drivers liking certain circuits, among other factors.
"The last few races have not been great for us, but I think we’re getting stronger again and Austin is probably a better circuit for our car."
The clash between Norris and team-mate Oscar Piastri in the Singapore sprint may also come up again this weekend, though McLaren appears to have drawn a line under the incident.

There has been more driver news since the Singapore Grand Prix, as Haas confirmed it will give Formula 2 points leader Rafael Camara his F1 debut in 2027. The 21-year-old Brazilian is replacing Esteban Ocon and will likely line up alongside incumbent Oliver Bearman, once a few contractual details have been ironed out.
It completes a rapid rise for Camara, who won F3 in 2025 and FRECA the year before, and means that outside of Haas, in theory, the only seats left to be confirmed for 2027 are at Racing Bulls.

Liam Lawson and Arvid Lindblad currently compete for the Faenza outfit and have both contributed to Racing Bulls leading the midfield, sitting fifth on 100 points. While it is all but guaranteed that rookie Lindblad, who is 11th with 38 points, will return for next season, question marks linger around ninth-placed Lawson.

Not that they should: the 24-year-old Kiwi is in the form of his life with points in every race bar five. But, as is the case with Red Bull, there is another young driver on its conveyor belt, and that is Camara’s F2 title rival Nikola Tsolov.

The Austrian company has a decision to make: whether to keep Lawson or give Tsolov a chance. It’s just a case of where does Lawson go from here? A return to Red Bull, where he started 2025, is unlikely considering Isack Hadjar’s form, whereas staying at Racing Bulls long-term is not really a viable option for any party.
So expect those questions this weekend. But as things stand, Lawson is expected to stay for 2027 with 2028 perhaps being the year he needs to find a new team.
How many track limit breaches this year?
Pierre Gasly, Alpine, Franco Colapinto, Alpine

“I’m going to put a pillow from the hotel under his butt, so he can actually see the road,” were the words of Mercedes boss Toto Wolff at the Singapore GP. It was in response to Antonelli breaching track limits on four occasions which, in theory, is the threshold for a five-second penalty. But the Italian escaped it, given brake issues caused one of them.

Nevertheless, track limits is something Antonelli has often struggled with and, much to his dismay, no doubt they will be a huge topic this weekend. They always are around COTA due to its extremely long run-off areas and high-speed bends, with 32 laps being deleted in last year’s race.
That is more than most on the calendar, so it will no doubt be another talking point this weekend - particularly so in qualifying, where drivers are pushing the limits more than in any other session.

items.originalTitle: Hockenheim in talks with F1 despite “virtually zero” public funding
detailZh: 霍肯海姆尽管“几乎没有”公共资金支持，仍在与F1进行谈判
霍肯海姆在启动“移动之家”的同时，仍然希望举办F1赛事
霍肯海姆正在与一级方程式进行“讨论”，关于德国赛道可能回归的可能性，但该项目目前仍处于“很大程度上理论化”的阶段
霍肯海姆赛道的管理总监约恩·特斯克和乔奇恩·内佩尔在Motorsport.com的姐妹出版物Formel1.de的采访中详细讨论了这个问题，因为该巴登-符腾堡州的赛道推出了Motorworld，它被描述为“一个独特的中心，将赛车运动、零售、车间、服务提供商、商业、酒店、餐饮、活动和汽车热情汇集在一个屋檐下”。
巴登-符腾堡州的这条赛道首次在1970年举办了德国大奖赛，并在1977年至2006年期间一直是F1赛历上的固定项目，之后改为每年举办两次，最初与纽博格林赛道交替进行。2019年，在梅赛德斯的赞助下举办了一场最终赛事，但由于复杂的财务状况，进一步的赛事变得不可行。
如今，F1拥有24轮的赛历，有许多潜在的候选地，包括预计将在2030年代初加入的卢旺达，但霍肯海姆赛道仍然有兴趣将世界锦标赛作为其旗舰赛事。
“F1自然非常关注霍肯海姆赛道正在发生的事情，”特斯克说。
“我们正在进行讨论。当然，F1的首要任务是确保霍肯海姆赛道的整体条件适宜。汽车世界是一个美丽的建筑，但它并不是F1举办赛事的必要元素。我想他的重点将更多地放在整体基础设施是否适宜。尽管如此，我们发布的图片给每个人都留下了深刻印象，我包括F1首席执行官斯蒂法诺·多梅尼卡利在内。这仅仅是一个了不起的建筑，它象征着赛道上真正在向前发展的事实。”
Nerpel澄清说，如果Hockenheim想要再次举办一级方程式赛车比赛，它将需要临时看台，以便从“不到60,000个座位”增加到“接近10万个”，以及一个更大的维修区来容纳所有11支车队。
但问题的关键，正如经常发生的那样，是财务问题。Nerpel补充说：“我们经常坐在这里说，'你看过匈牙利那个维修区吗？'” “类似的东西几乎是一夜之间建成的——我故意使用这个短语，因为那些建筑在六到九个月内就建成了。
“这是两种完全不同的方法。当一个政府或国家表示兴趣并说，'这对我们很重要'——以卢旺达为例，它现在已经成为讨论的一部分——我们有时会想，一级方程式在德国的地位是多么微不足道，德国是一个以汽车工业著称的国家，对它的支持是多么少。当然，我们希望得到更多的支持，但如果我这么说的话，从任何来源获得公共资金的可能性几乎是零。
“有许多问题需要先解决，”Teske确认说。 “由于我们目前没有实质性的内容可以公开宣布或讨论，这仍然基本上是理论上的。”
在伊朗战争背景下，日历的不确定性正在减弱，Teske 也澄清说，从财务角度来看，一场临时性的单次替换比赛‘肯定不值得’Hockenheim去做。
“让我这样来说：如果举办一场替换比赛能显著打开一条通往多年合同和稳定一级方程式未来的大门，那么这肯定是我们会非常认真考虑的选项，”Teske 说。
“但如果很明显，这只是一场单次替换比赛，没有进一步的前景，我个人会质疑这样的努力是否值得。从财务角度来看，这肯定是不值得的。
“一场单独的比赛能带来什么持久的价值？一次媒体关注的爆发，该活动的巨大曝光度，然后一切又都消失了。这不一定是我想要的，尽管我必须强调，这只是我个人的观点，并且还没有在内部达成一致。”
目前F1赛场上22名车手中有14位曾在霍肯海姆赛道参赛，其中三位曾获得胜利——费尔南多·阿隆索（’05、’10、’12年）、刘易斯·汉密尔顿（’06、’16、’18年）和马克斯·维斯塔潘（’19年）。当地英雄迈克尔·舒马赫是纪录保持者，共获得四次胜利。
detailEn: Hockenheim in talks with F1 despite “virtually zero” public funding
As it launches a “home of mobility”, Hockenheim still wishes for an F1 race
Hockenheim is “in discussions” with Formula 1 regarding a potential return to the German track, but the project remains “largely theoretical” at this stage.

The Hockenheimring’s managing directors Joern Teske and Jochen Nerpel addressed the matter at length in an interview with Motorsport.com sister publication Formel1.de, as the Baden-Wuerttemberg-based circuit launched Motorworld, which it described as “a unique centre that brings together motorsport, retail, workshops, service providers, business, hotels, catering, events and a passion for motoring under one roof”.

The Baden-Wuerttemberg-based circuit first hosted the German Grand Prix in 1970 and was a staple on the F1 calendar from 1977 to 2006 before moving to biannual appearances until 2018, initially alternating with the Nurburgring. A final event was organised in 2019 with backing from Mercedes, but tricky financial conditions made any further races unfeasible.

Nowadays, F1 has a 24-round calendar with a number of potential candidates – including Rwanda, which is set to join in the early 2030s – but Hockenheim is still interested in making the world championship its flagship event.
“Formula 1 is naturally watching very closely what is happening here at the Hockenheimring,” Teske said.

“We are in discussions. Formula 1's priority, of course, is that the overall conditions at the Hockenheimring are right. Motorworld is a beautiful building, but it isn't the essential element Formula 1 needs to stage a race. I imagine his focus will be more on whether the overall infrastructure is suitable. That said, the images we released impressed everyone, and I would include [F1 CEO] Stefano Domenicali in that. It is simply a fantastic building, and it symbolises the fact that things really are moving forward at the circuit.”

Nerpel clarified that Hockenheim would need temporary grandstands if it were to host F1 again, in order to go from “just under 60,000 seats” to “close to 100,000”, as well as a larger pit building to accommodate all 11 teams.

But the crux of the issue, as is often the case, is financial. “We often sit here and say, 'Have you seen that pit building in Hungary?'” Nerpel added. “Something like that gets built almost overnight – and I use that phrase deliberately, because those buildings went up in something like six to nine months.

“These are two completely different approaches. When a government or a country shows an interest and says, 'This matters to us' – look at Rwanda, for example, which is now part of the discussion – we sometimes think it is extraordinary how little standing Formula 1 has in Germany, a country famous for its automotive industry, and how little support there is for it. Naturally, we would like much more backing, but the chances of public funding coming from any source are virtually zero, if I may put it that way.”
“There are many issues to resolve first,” Teske confirmed. “Since we have nothing substantial to announce or discuss publicly at this stage, it remains largely theoretical.”

Amid subsiding calendar uncertainty in the context of the Iran war, Teske also clarified that a last-minute, one-off replacement race ‘certainly wouldn’t be worthwhile’ for Hockenheim from a financial standpoint.

“Let me put it this way: if taking on a replacement race opened the door significantly wider to a multi-year contract and a secure Formula 1 future, then it would certainly be an option we would examine very seriously,” Teske said.

“But if it were clear that it would be just a one-off replacement race, with no further prospects, I would personally question whether the effort was worthwhile. Financially, it certainly wouldn't be.

“What lasting value would a single race bring? One burst of media attention, huge visibility for that event, and then it all fades away again. That wouldn't necessarily be my preference, although I must stress that this is just my personal opinion and hasn't been agreed internally.”

Fourteen of the current 22 drivers on the F1 grid have raced at the Hockenheimring, with three claiming victories – Fernando Alonso (’05, ’10, ’12), Lewis Hamilton (’06, ’16, ’18) and Max Verstappen (’19). Local hero Michael Schumacher is the record holder, with four wins to his name.

items.titleZh: 国际汽联叫停F1轮辋研发竞赛
items.summaryZh: 国际汽联已采取行动，阻止F1出现一场围绕轮辋设计的新研发竞赛，避免只用于排位的轮辋成为必备装备。2026年规则允许车队自行设计轮辋后，各队发现优化轮胎温度可带来收益，法拉利在巴塞罗那大奖赛引入新轮辋帮助后轮冷却，并助力汉密尔顿夺冠。
items.originalTitle: Why an F1 arms race has been stopped before it could start
items.summaryEn: The FIA has moved to stop a potential new development arms race in Formula 1 over wheel rim designs, preventing qualifying-only rims from becoming a must-have item. After the 2026 rules allowed teams to design their own rims again, teams found gains in optimising tyre temperatures, with Ferrari introducing new rims at the Barcelona Grand Prix to improve rear cooling and help Lewis Hamilton take victory.
detailZh: 国际汽联已采取行动，阻止F1出现一场潜在的新研发竞赛，这场竞赛可能导致只用于排位的轮辋成为必备装备。
2026年F1规则的关键变化之一是放弃标准轮辋，车队再次获得使用自行设计轮辋的自由。
这引发了一场引人关注的升级竞争，因为各车队逐渐意识到优化轮胎温度可以带来收益。
例如在巴塞罗那大奖赛上，法拉利引入了新轮辋以帮助改善后轮冷却，这些轮辋在刘易斯·汉密尔顿为该队夺冠的过程中发挥了作用。
其他车队也效仿法拉利，在全年中调整了轮辋设计——尤其是迈凯伦，它一直试图通过新的轮辋设计来帮助更好地预热前轮胎、并更多地冷却后轮胎。
F1轮胎供应商倍耐力表示，年初就已明显看出，车队自己的设计在控制轮胎温度方面产生了多大影响。
其首席工程师西蒙·贝拉解释道：“这是一个相当显著的变化。
“我们今年看到的是，总体稳定后的条件比过去低得多，这是因为轮辋基本上在冷却整个车轮以及轮胎本身。”
各车队在今年过程中取得的进展表明，冬季在这一领域的研发很可能会加速。
这引发了国际汽联内部的担忧，因为明显的性能收益摆在眼前，车队可能会将其推向极端。
其中一项担忧是，一些车队可能会选择投入大量资源，为排位赛使用一种轮辋设计，而为正赛使用另一种。
这样做的好处是，可以让轮胎温度针对单个飞驰圈进行优化——可能是通过更多地加热前轮或后轮来帮助完善平衡——然后在正赛中再进行调整，此时的目标是尽可能长时间地保持橡胶冷却。
考虑到这一风险以及可能随之而来的军备竞赛，国际汽联已推动对F1 2027年技术规则进行修改，以杜绝各队走这条路线。
这些修改本周已获国际汽联世界汽车运动理事会批准，并将从2027年初开始生效。
新规要求，从冲刺赛或正赛前赛车进入封闭车检区（pre-parc ferme）时起，只能使用“单一规格”的轮辋。
这意味着车队在每场排位赛和正赛中必须坚持使用相同规格的前后轮辋——不得在这两节比赛之间进行更换。
规则明确，一旦F1赛车带着轮辋驶离维修区，该轮辋即被视为已使用。
detailEn: The FIA has moved to close off a potential new development arms race in Formula 1 that could have led to qualifying-only wheel rims becoming a must-have item.
One of the key changes to F1’s 2026 rules was a move away from standard wheel rims, with teams having freedom once again to use their own designs.
This has led to an intriguing battleground of updates as teams have come to realise the benefits that can come from optimising tyre temperatures.
At the Barcelona Grand Prix, for example, Ferrari introduced new wheel rims to help improve cooling at the rear and these helped play a part in Lewis Hamilton taking victory for the squad.

Other outfits followed Ferrari’s lead in tweaking wheel rim designs over the course of the year – with McLaren in particular having pursued a path of trying to use new rim designs to help warm up its front tyres better and cool the rears more.
F1 tyre supplier Pirelli said it became obvious early in the year how much of an impact the teams’ own designs were having in controlling tyre temperatures.
Its chief engineer Simone Berra explained: “It's quite a significant variation.
“What we have seen this year is that generally stabilised conditions are much lower than in the past, and this is because the rim basically is cooling the whole wheel, and the tyres themselves.”
The gains teams had found over the course of this year pointed to a likely ramping up of development in this area over the winter.
This prompted concerns within the FIA about teams taking it to extremes because of the clear performance benefits on offer.
One of the worries was that some squads could choose to invest heavily in running one wheel rim design for qualifying and another for the race.

The benefit from this would be having tyre temperatures optimised for a single flying lap – potentially by firing up the fronts or the rears more to help perfect the balance – and then altered for the race when the aim is to keep the rubber cool for as long as possible.
Mindful about this risk, and the spending war that could have followed, the FIA has pushed through changes to F1’s 2027 regulations to stamp out this route being followed.
These were approved this week by the FIA's World Motor Sport Council and come into force from the start of 2027.
They demand that only a “single specification” of wheel rim may be used from the time the car is in pre-parc ferme before a sprint race or main grand prix.
This means that teams must stick to the same specification of front and rear wheel rims for each qualifying and race – with no scope to swap between the two sessions.
The rules clarify that wheel rims will be deemed to have been used once an F1 car has left the pitlane with the rims fitted.
keyPointsZh: 2026年规则的关键变化之一是放弃标准轮辋，车队重新获得自行设计轮辋的自由。
倍耐力首席工程师西蒙娜·贝拉表示，车队自有设计对轮胎温度控制的影响相当显著。
keyPointsEn: One of the key changes to the 2026 rules was moving away from standard wheel rims, giving teams freedom to use their own designs again.
Pirelli chief engineer Simone Berra said the impact of teams' own designs on controlling tyre temperatures was quite significant.
